summary: All six reported calculations reproduced. All 10 volcano labels agreed in direction in each contrast, and all 25 heatmap genes reversed. The registered split was 11 diet-up and 14 diet-down. Figure S6C reports 14 and 12 before one exclusion, which cannot yield 11 and 14. All 46 source hashes and sizes matched, but the saved GEO series page was a reCAPTCHA response. The corrected proposal cites the verified GEO family file and workbook, retains the selected-results comparison, and marks the directional discrepancy unresolved. It passed the repository proposal validator.
openIssues: The authors’ signed gene lists and the identity of the excluded gene are needed to reconcile Figure S6C.

All 10 diet labels met the authors’ discovery rule, while zero reached 10% FDR in the registered output. The reviewed sources do not provide the fitted gene-level statistics needed to explain that difference or establish full concordance.
